nodes.description: address public owner; contract owner, receives owner commission and holds exclusive rights
bytes32 public SHA256ofArtwork; cryptographic digest of the artwork
uint256 public editionSize; total number of pieces in the edition
string public fileLink; link to artwork file
string public proofLink; artist creation proof, set once via setProof
string public customText; arbitrary artist metadata
uint256 public ownerCommission; basis points paid to owner on each sale
uint256 public lowestAskPrice; current lowest ask in wei
address public lowestAskAddress; seller of the lowest ask, receives sale proceeds
uint256 public lowestAskTime; timestamp after which the sale can be cancelled
bool public pieceForSale; flag indicating an active ask
uint256 public highestBidPrice; highest bid held in escrow
uint256 public highestBidTime; timestamp after which the bid can be cancelled
uint public activationTime; deployment timestamp used for the one year Ethart lock
bool public pieceWanted; flag indicating an active bid
bool public proofSet; whether setProof has already been executed
uint256 ethartAward; number of pieces awarded to the Registrar/Ethart
mapping(address => uint256) public piecesOwned; ERC20-style balances of pieces
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed; ERC20 allowances
address registrar; hardcoded Ethart Registrar contract address, external call target
constructor Artwork(...) validating commission and initialising state
setProof(string) onlyBy(owner) sets proof and mints Ethart award using block.timestamp randomness
transfer(address,uint256) ERC20 transfer guarded by notLocked
burn(uint256) destroys own pieces and reduces editionSize
buyPiece() payable; splits msg.value into owner/Ethart/seller shares and performs external ETH sends plus issuePatrons
offerPieceForSale(uint256) sets the lowest ask, may call fillBid
placeBid() payable; escrows a bid, refunds previous bidder, may call buyPiece
fillBid() ownerFirst ethArtOnlyAfterOneYear notLocked; pays out bid via external transfers
cancelBid() onlyBy(highestBidAddress) refunds the bid after 24h
cancelSale() onlyBy(lowestAskAddress) cancels an ask after 24h
msg.sender; attacker controllable caller used for auth checks and balance updates
now / block.timestamp; miner-influenceable time used for locks and the Ethart award lottery
editionSize % 40 and (editionSize - remainder) / 40; Ethart award math
now % 39 <= remainder; timestamp-based lottery awarding an extra piece
onlyBy modifier parameter _account compared to msg.sender
local Interface a bound to registrar in buyPiece
local Interface a bound to registrar in fillBid
